title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore East on 1971-04-29
source: MSR  7 inch (7.5 ips) Revox A 77 >Alesis Masterlink>CD-R

ai_review.summary: Recording is criticized for being a commercial source rather than a true soundboard or audience capture; no musical details are provided.
ai_review.review: Both reviewers focus on the recording itself, lamenting that the available file appears to be taken from a commercial release and lacks the live ambience of an audience tape. No comments are made about the performance quality, setlist flow, or individual musicians.

ai_rating.rationale: Both reviews express dissatisfaction with the recording and give zero stars; no positive information about the show is offered, leading to a low overall rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewers note it seems derived from a commercial product, lacking the live feel of an audience recording; one reviewer prefers a separate audience tape that sounds better.
